name: signage-control-panel
description: Signage Control Panel - Process-Based Architecture Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "api,ws,dashboard" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w ws" "npm run dev -w dashboard"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "api,ws,dash,client" -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w ws" "npm run dev -w dashboard" "npm run dev:client"
